verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because a tax agency could expose machine channels. CRA's own sanctioned system-to-system channel is EFILE: certified tax software plus an enrolled electronic filer transmits returns without the web UI, and ReFILE covers amended returns. This is narrow, though. It is gated behind software certification and filer enrollment, limited to tax-return transmission, and nothing shows a general headless or CI mode for other services such as business registration, which are interactive web flows. missing for 10: a general-purpose API or headless access for core services such as business registration and payments, documentation for CI or automation use, an agent-oriented docs index (no llms.txt was found), and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
